articles.title: Google Pixel Watch 5: All you need to know
articles.description:
The Pixel Watch 5 arrived on 12 August and reaches shops on 20 August. Put it next to last year's model and you will struggle to tell them apart: same case, same screen, same two days between charges. Everything that changed is inside. The one worth knowing about is what happens to your run after you finish it, when Google reprocesses the track against its 3D map of every building on the planet and corrects the wandering lines you get between tall buildings. Blood pressure and insulin resistance readings follow in the autumn. It costs fifty dollars more than last year. Here is what you get for that, what it costs where you live, and whether it is worth leaving your Watch 4 behind.
